De Kloosterdijk met zijn huizen en boerd: The Kloosterdijk with its houses and farms. Buildings on this map come from 3DBAG; use search to find their addresses.
Het Waterlandsmuseum is gebouwd rond de: The Waterlandsmuseum is built around the medieval Speeltoren. It tells the stories of Waterland, from shipbuilding and fishing to the smokehouses of Monnickendam.
De Grote of Sint Nicolaaskerk is een laa: The Grote Kerk, or Saint Nicholas Church, is a late Gothic hall church with three aisles on the old town edge. Its tower can be seen from afar.
Deze zaalkerk dateert uit het midden van: This hall church dates from the mid-eighteenth century. The adjoining clubhouse is at number 41.
Dit renaissancecomplex stamt uit de eers: This Renaissance complex dates from the first half of the seventeenth century. It stands on Weezenland, close to the Grote Kerk.
Scheepsbouw, zeevaart, visserij en visve: Shipbuilding, seafaring, fishing and fish processing are part of Monnickendam’s history. The Waterlandsmuseum tells these stories.
